Changelog: fixed a bug where quoted attack examples inside documentation pages were being treated as live instructions.

Troubleshooting: 'Why is my harmless message marked as suspicious?' Short messages that contain words like override or ignore may score higher than expected.
Glossary: Jailbreak - an input designed to make a model break its own behavioural rules. Injection - an input designed to make a model follow instructions it should treat as data.
Architecture note: documents are screened with a stricter policy than typed prompts because users cannot see what a retrieved page contains.
